# E0201: the first schema is not version 0.0

Every lineage starts at version 0.0. Versions are contiguous from there, so a
lineage whose first schema is any other version has a gap before it.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0201]: the first schema is version 1.0, not 0.0
 --> lineage.cue:4:3
  |
4 |         "0": {
  |         ^^^
  |
  = help: every lineage starts at version 0.0
```
